title: Core Web Vitals and client performance
description: For public or customer-facing web pages: Core Web Vitals targets, field measurement and a lab check against regressions.

rules.instruction: For the pages the change affects, record LCP, INP and CLS targets at the 75th percentile of page loads, using the Web Vitals good thresholds (2.5 s, 200 ms, 0.1) unless the owner sets others.
rules.verification: Check that the performance budget file or the task record lists the three targets.

rules.instruction: Measure Core Web Vitals from real users for the affected pages, not only in a lab test.
rules.verification: Link the field data report for the affected pages, such as a real-user monitoring dashboard or the Chrome UX Report.

rules.instruction: Run a lab performance check on the affected pages in CI and compare it with the previous release.
rules.verification: Check the CI report for the before and after values of the affected pages.
